events.title: SYK Q1 Deep Dive: Cyber Incident Disrupts Operations, Management Reiterates Full-Year Outlook
events.body: Medical technology company Stryker (NYSE:SYK) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q1 CY2026 as sales rose 2.6% year on year to $6.02 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.60 per share was 12.9% below analysts’ consensus estimates.

events.title: UFP Tech (UFPT) Q2 2025 Earnings Transcript
events.body: R. Jeffrey Bailly: Thank you, Ron, and thank you to everyone joining the call. UFP had a strong second quarter. Revenue from our two largest customers, Intuitive Surgical and Stryker, grew 10% and 567%, respectively.
